If you hit a limit, you’ll receive a `429 Too Many Requests` status code. - **Permissions**: Ensure your API key has the necessary permissions. If you don’t see the vote reflected, double‑check the key’s scope. - **Verification**: After submission, you can verify the vote by querying the IP resource again: ```python def get_ip_info(api_key, ip_address): url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}" headers = {"x-apikey": api_key} response = requests.get(url, headers=headers) return response.json() print(get_ip_info("key_four", "22.242.75.136")) ``` That should give you the updated information, including your vote.
